The agent instead rescales x and y to the observed min/max range before binning, which changes the semantics of the output labels. Its notes even claim this happens per session/day, but the code actually performs the rescaling separately inside each 1-minute trial.

The agent adds several silent repairs: partial-NaN zero-filling, trace/position truncation to the shorter stream, normalization of ragged `blocked` entries, session skipping when fewer than two trials remain, and invalid-position remapping to `-1`.
